name: BuildingEnergyBenchmark
tagline: Benchmark every building, see your emissions-limit penalties now and in 2030, and file on time.
description: Complete building energy benchmarking and building performance standard compliance app for Power Apps and Power Pages: site/source EUI, peer comparison, emissions vs limits by period, penalties, 2030 pathway, retrofit what-if with payback and a four-eyes filing workflow.
features: Site and source EUI from annual meter totals (electricity, gas, steam, oil)
Configurable emission factors, limits per property type and compliance periods
Penalty now and projected period-2 penalty
Pathway chart with retrofit plan and grid decarbonisation
Retrofit what-if: efficiency, heat pumps, solar, cost, payback
Filing workflow with four-eyes review, deadlines, rejection and amendment
Drag-and-drop filing board with rule checks
pack: Niray Real Estate & Facilities PCF Pack
controlType: standard (2 controls: BuildingEnergyBenchmark data-set, BuildingEnergyBenchmarkPortal field)
